instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a row of single-story small office studios made up of administration, open studio, and support segments. The operations team wants the model to reflect a realistic rhythm with weekday peaks, limited Saturday use, and a Sunday setback instead of constant all-day loads. Preserve the three-part space organization and the south-facing daylight order while completing distinct space types, people, lighting, equipment loads, and rule-based operating schedules. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
